title: [WT-18c] Docs: worker role docs for the unlanded route, LANDING-CONFLICT/RETRY resume and WT-10 gate wording
description:
This is the second worker-role-doc slice split from WT-18 (task-1b2e6fe3ba1343c8ab02271510131155). Its shape follows architect-0fcb7226 in #architects msg-ba081c4f.

It runs once WT-10 (task-5c2e6cdf2494412ca0c2bc40e26d9da3), WT-11 (task-dd1ee586b90d4fc785434454b1423e76) and WT-18a (task-692a12df337c43edacb59fd0599ecff2) have landed. It touches no wrapper-lane file, so it can run alongside WT-12/WT-13. It must land before this project's worktree switch; the human approved that early switch (flip checklist pinned in #general msg-717a48e0).

Objective: document for workers what HEAD's landed wrappers do, and only that:
- the unlanded route (finalize_attempt outcome 'unlanded', the rescue ref, task.landingRetry), as a row in worker.reference.md's commits table;
- the practical rule for a session whose prompt starts with LANDING-CONFLICT: or LANDING-RETRY:, as WT-11's wrappers implement it;
- any completion-gate wording that WT-10 changed.

Files:
- docs/roles/worker.md
- docs/roles/worker.reference.md
- packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts, regenerated from a `git clone --shared` snapshot as in WT-18a. The GLOBAL no-in-place-build rail applies.

NOT in scope: CLAUDE.md, scripts/CLAUDE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (WT-18), and any behaviour that is not on HEAD.
definitionOfDone: worker.reference.md's commits table has an unlanded-route row matching HEAD's WT-11 wrappers: finalize_attempt outcome 'unlanded', the rescue ref and task.landingRetry, with codes spelled as on HEAD.

worker.md or worker.reference.md states the rule for a session whose prompt starts with LANDING-CONFLICT: or LANDING-RETRY:, as HEAD's WT-11 wrappers implement it, plus any completion-gate wording WT-10 changed; nothing beyond HEAD is presented as shipped.
`npm run lint` passes (40-line cap); worker.md contains no concrete task id and keeps its test sentinels.

packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts equals the generator output from a snapshot and changes only the worker-doc entries; the targetedContextGuidance, qaCommitPolicy and initFiles vitest files pass there.
